content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["The remake was rushed and focused too much on Chicken George’s life at the expense of Kunta, Fiddler, and Kizzy.", "The conflict between George and his eldest son Tom was poorly handled.", "The omission of the poor white George was terrible.", "The relationship with Kunta and the wrestler during the middle passage was cut.", "The series turned Roots into an after‑school special and made many bad changes to appease today’s generation.", "The production altered key elements of Alex Haley’s original story, including changing Kizzy’s gender.", "The overall adaptation was described as corny and a fabrication that destroyed the original masterpiece."]}
